data.cultural_impact: The name Henryson may have cultural significance in various ways. For instance, in Scotland, the surname "Henryson" is associated with the Border Reivers. These were families that lived in the debatable lands between Scotland and England, and the Reivers were known for their raids and cattle rustling. The name "Henryson," therefore, was borne by many of these families, denoting their status as sons of the powerful Henrys who ruled in these lands.
